name: A Room With A View
accommodation: Individually styled rooms from singles to deluxe kings, some with sea views towards the pier; no lift
suitableFor: Couples and solo travellers wanting a smaller seafront B&B
parking: Car park for up to ten cars; free private parking when booking direct
beachAccess: On Marine Parade in Kemptown, listed under the seafront by Visit Brighton
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast, sea-view rooms, guest lounge, Wi-Fi, private car park
overview: A Room With A View is a guest house in a Grade II listed Georgian building on Marine Parade in Kemptown, facing the sea. Rooms range from singles to deluxe kings, each styled differently, and some look along the coast to the pier. Its own car park, holding up to ten cars, is a rare thing on this stretch of seafront.
surfTripFit: Free private parking right on the seafront makes it easy to load and unload boards, and the beach is across the road.
